brief: For x = 1e9, compute the partial Mertens product P_7(x) = prod over primes p == 7 mod 8 with 7 <= p <= x of (1 - 1/p) in PARI, and compare against the L(s, chi_8)-derived lower bound (exp(-Euler)/log x)^(1/4) * (1 - 1/(2 (log x)^2)). Also evaluate cambie_depth3_check at the largest prime p == 7 mod 8 below 1e9: predicate c2/(4p^2) >= 9849/10000 with N=(3p-1)/4, c2 = 3p^2 - p + 2(p-1)*eulerphi(N). Report both numerical results and slack at the seam.

rounds.claimText: For x = 1000000000, the partial Mertens product P_7(x) = prod over primes p with p == 7 mod 8 and 7 <= p <= x of (1 - 1/p) admits the explicit L(s, chi_8)-derived lower bound P_7(x) >= (exp(-Euler)/log(x))^(1/4) * (1 - 1/(2 * (log x)^2)), with slack at x = 1000000000 expected to exceed the 28 percent headroom measured at x = 1000000, testable by direct PARI computation as: default(realprecision,30); X=1000000000; P=1.0; ct=0; forprime(p=7,X,if(p%8==7,P*=1-1.0/p; ct+=1)); print(P); print((exp(-Euler)/log(X))^0.25 * (1 - 1/(2*log(X)^2))); print(P/((exp(-Euler)/log(X))^0.25 * (1 - 1/(2*log(X)^2)))).
